name: 66612 · Topeka, KS
findings: ZIP 66612 (Topeka) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66612 (Topeka) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
